effect:
Boosts Attack but causes confusion. (Hold)

A Gen 2 classic. Sharply raises Attack when you switch in, but confuses you. One-time use.

Own Tempo users completely ignore the confusion, so they just get a free Attack boost. Also decent on anything running Outrage since you're getting confused after anyway.
